release_notes:
API price sync fixes, bulk margin feature, and update page fixes.

Cron fixes (IMEI / File / Server):
- apiserviceprices_dhru.php was IMEI-only; now handles all three service types by making one imeiservicelist call per API and calling autoUpdatePrices() for IMEI, File, and Server
- apiserviceprices.php Dhru section replaced N+1 per-service getimeiservicedetails calls with a single imeiservicelist call covering all types
- Deleted api_imeiservices_prices_dhru.php — was a byte-for-byte duplicate

Bulk auto-update margin (Quick Price Change page):
- New "Set Auto-Update Price Margin" section on the Quick Price Change page
- Service type auto-deduced from URL (no manual selection)
- Supplier API dropdown filters which services are targeted
- Service Category dropdown populates dynamically per service type and API; repopulates on API change
- Margin can be flat amount or percentage, applied to default price or all price plans
- On save, immediately recalculates and applies retail price using stored CostPrice; cron then maintains the rule on future API cost changes

Update page fixes:
- Fixed invisible "Software Version" portlet title (grey-steel is not a valid Metronic variant)
- Fixed missing icons: fa-server → fa-desktop, fa-file-archive-o → fa-archive, fa-database → fa-hdd-o

Encrypter fix:
- scripts/encrypt.php now correctly skips nested vendor directories (e.g. admincp/mpdf/vendor/) so Composer-managed files are never encrypted and do not require bolt.so on customer servers
